comment: Hand-written reachability metadata for the Kotlin/Native compiler native image.
Unlike '../kotlin-native-compiler-traced', it is not regenerated by the tracing agent: it covers what tracing captures only partially.
Reflection: CLI arguments are parsed reflectively via property setters, while the agent records only the setters of the arguments used during tracing.
Reflection: URL protocol handlers enable http(s) URLs, which cache builds construct when resolving the dependencies of the distribution.
Resources: tracing records only the jansi native library of the host it runs on.
